name: Frostmane Hold
summary: In the peaks above Iceflow Lake, Frostmane trolls guard their cavern stronghold. Senir Whitebeard, stationed in Kharanos, sends scouts inside to kill headhunters and bring back intelligence for his reports.

sections.title: A Scout Behind Schedule
sections.body: Senir Whitebeard tracks the Frostmane threat across Dun Morogh from Kharanos. The mountaineer and scout followed the aggressive tribes to their main cavern southwest of Brewnall Village, but armed trolls crowd its entrance. Senir is falling severely behind on his official reports, and he will not enter alone. He hires passing adventurers to scout the icy cavern in his place.

sections.title: Breaching the Cavern
sections.body: Carved into the western peaks above Iceflow Lake, the stronghold is a freezing refuge packed with hostile ice trolls. Scouts must fight through its underground tunnels, kill the Frostmane Headhunters stationed along the ledges, and map the interior. The survivors' findings give Senir the intelligence he needs to complete his report for Ironforge's military commanders.

faq.answer: Frostmane Hold lies southwest of Brewnall Village, in a cavern on the far western side of Dun Morogh. From Kharanos, follow the road north to the bridge, then take the frozen river west past Iceflow Lake to Brewnall Village and climb southwest into the mountains.
Senir Whitebeard is a dwarven scout stationed outside the Thunderbrew Distillery in Kharanos. He tracks threats across Dun Morogh and writes reports on the aggressive Frostmane trolls.

faq.q: Why didn't Senir explore the hold himself?
faq.answer: Senir scouted the entrance and found the tribe gathered there, but so many armed trolls filled the cave that he feared entering alone. He is worried for his safety and running late on his scouting deadlines, so he leaves the dangerous scouting to capable adventurers.

The Frostmane are an ice troll tribe native to the snowy crags of Dun Morogh. They are bitter enemies of the Ironforge dwarves and gnomes, and often raid trade routes, camps, and settlements from hidden encampments across the region.

faq.q: What happens after completing the recon of the hold?
faq.answer: When you return with news of the cavern's layout and the headhunters killed, Senir finishes his report and asks you to deliver the urgent papers to his superiors in Dun Morogh.

faq.q: How deep into the cave do you have to go?
faq.answer: You need to explore well beyond the entrance, scout the interior chambers, and slay five Frostmane Headhunters. Their deaths confirm that the cavern's depths have been thoroughly investigated.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you know the Frostmane trolls contest Ironforge's hold over Dun Morogh's snowy peaks. Scouting their main cavern stronghold helps defend the realm.
As a gnome, you know that after Gnomeregan fell, gnomes settled across Dun Morogh and Kharanos. Curbing the Frostmane attacks helps keep refugee supply corridors safe.
As an Alliance member, you help secure Dun Morogh and keep the mountain roads linking Ironforge to neighboring kingdoms free from hostile tribal ambushes.
